verdict.rationale: Sift documents Review Queues as a product feature alongside Workflows, and community evidence confirms human analysts do review flagged users to make final decisions, supporting the general workflow. However, there is no evidence detailing the review queue UI showing customer history, similar cases, or signal context in one view. missing for 10: documentation/screenshots of review queue UI showing customer history and similar cases, evidence of consolidated signal context, independent hands-on confirmation of queue usability.
